RCT of antioxidants (vitamin C, E, beta-carotene, selenium). Outcomes are platelet aggregation and activation markers, not mortality.

RCT of antioxidants in athletes. Outcomes are neutrophil antioxidant enzyme activities, not mortality.
Methodological paper on detecting bias in meta-analyses using funnel plots. Not a primary RCT of antioxidant supplements.
RCT of ascorbate with/without iron. Outcomes are oxidative DNA damage markers, not mortality.
